description: This Java source file defines the class JmsServiceEngine, which extends AbstractEngine. It handles JMS messaging functionality within the Apache OFBiz framework, including sending messages to topics and queues, handling different messaging modes, JNDI lookups, and transaction enlistment.

classes.name: JmsServiceEngine
classes.description: This class handles JMS messaging operations such as sending messages to topics and queues, including support for XA transactions, within the Apache OFBiz framework.

methods.name: JmsServiceEngine
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service engine with a dispatcher.

methods.name: getServiceElement
methods.description: Retrieves the JMS service configuration element based on the provided model service.

methods.name: makeMessage
methods.description: Creates a JMS MapMessage containing serialized service context and name.

methods.name: serverList
methods.description: Processes server elements based on send mode and returns the list of server configurations.

methods.name: runTopic
methods.description: Sends a message to a JMS topic using the provided server configuration.

methods.name: runQueue
methods.description: Sends a message to a JMS queue using the provided server configuration.

methods.name: runXaQueue
methods.description: Sends a message to a JMS XA queue, enlisting resources and managing transactions.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the messaging process based on the service configuration, handling multiple servers.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes the run process synchronously and returns the result.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Executes the run process synchronously, ignoring the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Executes the run process asynchronously and sends the result to a requester.

methods.description: Executes the run process asynchronously without a requester.
